data.description:
## Problem (finding P0-2a — separate from the seam-conversion work)
projects_store.set_project (projects_store.py) accepts ANY string key with no validation:
it does not call fetcher._validate_project_key, so a syntactically-invalid or malformed
key (e.g. "le-g", "", "1x", a key with whitespace/casing quirks) is written to
projects.json and only fails much later, deep in the reconciler fan-out. A validation
guard at write time would have rejected the malformed input that contributed to the
incident class (05b8-4efe-8d58-4c27).

## Scope note
This is a NEW behavior (input validation), NOT a hand-rolled->seam conversion. Filed
separately from ticket fea4 (pure seam conversion) so it can be approved/prioritized on
its own. It does NOT modify any shared seam and adds no facade.

## Approach
set_project validates the key with the EXISTING fetcher._validate_project_key (import and
reuse it — do NOT duplicate the _PROJECT_KEY_RE regex) and rejects an invalid key with a
clear non-zero error (and no file write). Consider remove_project symmetry only if it can
receive an unvalidated key. Do not add Jira-existence checking here (that is the reconciler
preflight, ticket a011) — this is syntactic validation only.

## Acceptance criteria
1. set_project("le-g"/""/"1x", ...) exits/raises non-zero with a clear message and writes
   nothing.
2. A valid key ("REB", "PROJ_2") is accepted unchanged.
3. Reuses fetcher._validate_project_key; no duplicated regex, no seam change.

## Test plan
- RED unit: set_project with each invalid key raises/exits non-zero and leaves
  projects.json unwritten; a valid key still writes.

## Sequencing
Edits projects_store.py (+ tests) — same file as ticket fea4. Sequence AFTER fea4 to avoid
a file conflict (rebase onto it). Approval-gated: this is additional scope beyond the seam
conversion.
data.title: Validate project key at write time in projects_store.set_project (reuse _validate_project_key)
